mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.name, u.province, u.address, u.admin_department, u.website, u.admission_website, u.contact_number, u.type, u.level, u.student_count, u.teacher_count, u.library_count, u.campus_area, u.introduction, u.departments, u.majors, u.admission_rules, u.scholarships, u.accommodation, u.contact_info FROM university u WHERE u.id = #{id}
SELECT id, university_id, province, year, score_required, plan_count, actual_count, lowest_rank FROM admission WHERE university_id = #{universityId}
SELECT id, university_id, category, rating, rating_count FROM satisfaction_rating WHERE university_id = #{universityId}
SELECT id, university_id, major_category, rating, recommendation_count FROM recommendation_rating WHERE university_id = #{universityId}
SELECT YEAR(created_at) AS year, COUNT(*) AS university_count FROM university GROUP BY YEAR(created_at) ORDER BY year ASC
SELECT province AS province, COUNT(*) AS count FROM university GROUP BY province
SELECT DISTINCT type FROM university ORDER BY type
SELECT DISTINCT level FROM university ORDER BY level
SELECT DISTINCT province FROM university ORDER BY province
SELECT DISTINCT admin_department FROM university WHERE admin_department IS NOT NULL ORDER BY admin_department

SELECT AVG(student_count) as avgStudentCount, MAX(student_count) as maxStudentCount, AVG(teacher_count) as avgTeacherCount, AVG(library_count) as avgLibraryCount, AVG(campus_area) as avgCampusArea FROM university WHERE level = #{level}
SELECT category, rating, rating_count as ratingCount FROM satisfaction_rating WHERE university_id = #{universityId} ORDER BY rating DESC
SELECT category as name, rating, rating_count as count FROM satisfaction_rating WHERE university_id = #{universityId} AND category NOT IN ('综合评价', '环境', '生活') ORDER BY rating DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT major_category as name, recommendation_count as count FROM recommendation_rating WHERE university_id = #{universityId} ORDER BY recommendation_count DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT major_category as name, rating, recommendation_count as count FROM recommendation_rating WHERE university_id = #{universityId} ORDER BY rating DESC, recommendation_count DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT i.id, i.title, i.content, i.user_id, i.status, i.created_at, u.username as user_name FROM interaction i LEFT JOIN user u ON i.user_id = u.user_id WHERE i.university_id = #{universityId} AND i.is_public = 1 ORDER BY i.created_at DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT id, university_id as universityId, province, year, score_required as scoreRequired, plan_count as planCount, actual_count as actualCount, lowest_rank as lowestRank FROM admission WHERE university_id = #{universityId} ORDER BY province, year DESC
